a: Velaggoren yafe sela – asur lehanot hemennu. aval im secharo mehayyom bedinar leyom, velaggoren yafe sela – muttar.

Vei salka datach "kor bishloshim, sea besela ani mocher lach" – rishon rishon kana; hacha name – kamma kamma mifsak pesak, veasur lehanot hemennu; middinar leyom velaggoren yafe sela – muttar?! ammay? veha agar "netar li" hu!
Amar rava: vetisbera?! zalzole bischirut mi asir?! may shena resha umay shena sefa?
Resha dela ka aved bahadeh mehasheta, michaze ki agar "netar li"; sefa deka aved bahadeh mehasheta, la michaze ki agar "netar li".

Veim haya mechubbar bekarka, vetalash kol shehu – kana. mishshum detalash kol shehu – kana?! amar rav sheshet: hacha bemay askinan – deamar leh: lech, yappe lecha karka kol shehu, vekane kol ma shealeha.

Mishna hammocher yayin vashemen lachavero, vehukeru o shehuzelu, im ad shello nitmallet hammidda – lammocher. mishshennitmallet hammidda – lallokeach. veim haya sarsur benehen, nishbera hechavit – nishbera lassarsur.
Vechayyayv lehattif lo shalosh tippin. hirkinah umitztzet – hare hu shel mocher. vehachenvoni – eno chayyayv lehattif shalosh tippin. rabbi yehuda omer: erev shabbat im chashecha – patur.
Gemara ha midda, deman? illema midda delokeach, ad shello nitmallet midda – lammocher?! midda delokeach hi! veella midda democher? mishshennitmallet midda – lallokeach?! midda democher hi!

Amar rabbi ila: bemiddat sarsur. veha middekatane sefa: veim haya sarsur benehem, nishbera hechavit – nishbera lassarsur; mikkelal deresha lav besarsur askinan! resha – midda belo sarsur, sefa – besarsur atzmo.

Hirkinah umitztzet – hare hu shel mocher. ki salek rabbi elazar, ashkecheh lizeri, amar leh: mi kan tanna deatneyeh rav middot? achavyeh rav yitzchak bar avdimi. amar leh: may ka kashya lach? ditnan: hirkinah umitztzita – hare hu shel mocher,
b: Vehatnan, hirkinah umitztzah – hare zo teruma!
Amar leh: ha ittemar ala, amar rabbi avahu: mishshum yeush bealim nagu bah.
Vehachenvoni eno chayyayv lehattif vechulei. ibbaya lehu: rabbi yehuda – aresha kae, ulekulla; o dilma assefa kae, ulechumera?
Ta shema: detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: erev shabbat im chashecha – chenvoni patur, mippene shechenvoni tarud.

Mishna hashsholeach et beno etzel chenvoni ufondeyon beyado, umadad lo beissar shemen venatan lo et haissar; shavar et hatztzelochit veibbed et haissar – chenvoni chayyayv. rabbi yehuda poter, sheal menat ken shelacho. umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bizman shehatztzelochit beyad hattinok umadad chenvoni letochah – shechenvoni patur.
Gemara bishlama beissar vashemen, beha peligi – derabbanan savri: leodoe shaddereh, verabbi yehuda savar: leshaddore leh shaddereh; ella shavar tzelochit – aveda middaat hi!

Amar rav hoshaya: hacha bevaal habbayit mocher tzelochiyyot askinan, uchegon shennetalah chenvoni al menat levakkerah; uchedishmuel – deamar shemuel: hannotel keli min haumman al menat levakkero, veneenas beyado – chayyayv.
Lema dishmuel tannae hi?! ella rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: hacha bechenvoni mocher tzelochiyyot askinan; veazda rabbi yehuda letameh, verabbanan letamayyhu.

I hachi, ema sefa – modim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bizman shehatztzelochit beyad hattinok, umadad chenvoni letochah – shechenvoni patur. veha amrat leodoe shaddereh! ella abbaye bar avin verabbi chanina bar avin deamri tarvayyhu: hacha bemay askinan –

a: Kegon shennetalah lamod bah, vechidrabba – deamar rabba: hikkishah – nitchayyev bah.
Emor deamar rabba – bevaale chayyim, deanketinhu nigra barayayta; ki hay gavna mi amar?!
Ella amar rava: ani vaari shebbachavura targemnuha – umannu? rabbi zera; hacha bemay askinan – kegon shennetalah lamod bah laacherim.
Uveshoel shello middaat ka mippalgi – mar savar: shoel have, umar savar: gazlan have.
Gufa – amar shemuel: hannotel keli min haumman levakkero, veneenas beyado – chayyayv. vehane mille hu dekaytzi demeh.
Hahu gavra deal leve tabbacha, agba atma devisra. bahade deka agba, ata parasha mirme minneh. ata lekammeh derav yemar, chayyeyveh leshallome demay. vehane mille hu dekaytzi demay.
Hahu gavra deayyti kare lefum nahara. ato kulle alma, shekul kara kara. amar lehu: hare hen mukedashin lashshamayim.
Ato lekammeh derav kahana, amar lehu: en adam makdish davar sheeno shello. vehane mille hu dekaytzi demayyhu, aval la kaytzi demayyhu – birshut marayyhu kayymi, veshappir akdesh.
Tanu rabbanan: hallokeach yarak min hashshuk, uverar vehinniach – afillu kol hayyom kullo, lo kana velo nitchayyev bemaaser.

Gamar belibbo liknoto – kana venitchayyev bemaaser. lehacheziro i efshar – shekkevar nitchayyev bemaaser, uleassero i efshar – shekkevar mafchitan bedamim. ha ketzad? meassero, venoten lo deme maaser.
Attu mishshum degamar belibbo liknot, kana venitchayyev bemaaser?! amar rav hoshaya: hacha bire shamayim askinan, kegon rav safra, dekayyem benafsheh "vedover emet bilvavo".
Mishna hassiton mekanneach middotav echad lishloshim yom. uvaal habbayit, echad lishnem asar chodesh. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: chilluf haddevarim.

Chenvoni, mekanneach middotav paamayim beshabbat, umemache mishkelotav paam achat beshabbat, umekannech moznayim al kol mishkal umishkal. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim – belach, aval beyavesh – eno tzarich.
b: Vechayyayv lehacheria lo tefach. haya shokel lo ayin beayin, noten lo gerumin. echad laasara ballach, veechad leesrim bayyavesh.
Makom shennahagu lamod bedakka – lo yamod begassa. begassa – lo yamod bedakka. limchok – lo yigdosh. ligdosh – lo yimchok.

Gemara menahane mille? amar resh lakish, deamar kera: "even shelema vatzedek" – tzaddek mishshellecha veten lo. i hachi, ema sefa: haya shokel lo ayin beayin – noten lo gerumin. vei hacheraa deorayyta, hechi yahev leh ayin beayin?

Ella resha bemakom shennahagu; vei ittemar deresh lakish – assefa ittemar: haya shokel lo ayin beayin – noten lo gerumin. menahane mille? amar resh lakish, deamar kera: "vatzedek" – tzaddek mishshellecha veten lo. vechamma gerumin? amar rabbi abba bar memel amar rav: echad measara ballitra ballach – laasara litrin.

Echad laasara ballach, veechad leesrim beyavesh vechulei. ibbaya lehu: hechi kaamar? echad measara ballach – laasara delach, veechad meesrim bayyavesh – leesrim deyavesh; o dilma, echad measara – laasara delach uleesrim deyavesh? teku.
Amar rabbi levi: kashe onshan shel middot yoter meonshan shel arayot, shezze neemar bahen "el", veze neemar bahen "elle". umay mashma dehay "el" – kashe hu? dichtiv: "veet ele haaretz lakach".
Gabbe arayot name, hachtiv "elle"! hahu lemaote middot mikkaret.
Veella may udepayyhu? dehatam efshar bitshuva, vehacha la efshar bitshuva.
Veamar rabbi levi: kashe gezel hedyot yoter miggezel gavoah, shezze hikdim "chet" limmeila", veze hikdim "meila" lechet".

Veamar rabbi levi: bo uree, shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam hakkadosh baruch hu – berach yisrael beesrim ushetayim, vekillelan bishmone. berchan beesrim ushetayim – meim bechukkotay" ad "kommiyyut";
Vekillelan bishmona – mivveim bechukkotay timasu" ad "veet chukkotay gaala nafsham".
Veillu moshe rabbenu – berchan bishmone, vekillelan beesrim ushetayim. berchan bishmone –

a: Mivvehaya im shamoa tishma", vead "leovdam"; vekillelan beesrim ushetayim – mivvehaya im lo tishma" ad "veen kone".
Makom shennahagu lamod begassa kulei. (siman: en meayyeynin, veen godshin, baagardemin, uvelitra, shelosha, vaeser, nefesh, mishkalot, mimmechak, ave, lo taasu, lo yaase.)
Tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheen mochakin bimkom sheggodshin, veen godshin bimkom shemmochakin? talmud lomar: "efa shelema".

Uminnayin sheim amar: hareni mochek bimkom sheggodshin – velifchot lo min haddamim, vahareni godesh bimkom shemmochakin – ulehosif lo al haddamim; sheen shomin lo? talmud lomar: "efa shelema vatzedek yihye lach".
Tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheen meayyeynin bimkom shemmachriin, veen machriin bimkom shemmeayyeynin? talmud lomar: "even shelema".

Uminnayin sheim amar: hareni meayyen bimkom shemmachriin – velifchot lo min haddamim, vahareni machria bimkom shemmeayyeynin – ulehosif lo al haddamim; sheen shomin lo? talmud lomar: "even shelema vatzedek".
Amar rav yehuda missura: "lo yihye lecha bevetcha" – ma taam? mishshum "efa veefa".
"Lo yihye lecha bechischa" – ma taam? mishshum "even vaaven". aval "even shelema vatzedek yihye lach, efa shelema vatzedek yihye lach".

Tanu rabbanan: "(lo) yihye lecha" – melammed shemmaamidin agardemin lammiddot, veen maamidin agardemin lashshearim. deve nesia okimu agardemin ben lammiddot ben lashshearim, amar leh shemuel lekarna: pok teni lehu: maamidin agardemin lammiddot, veen maamidin agardemin lashshearim.

Nefak derash lehu: maamidin agardemin ben lammiddot ben lashshearim. amar leh: ma shemach? karna. tippok leh karna beeneh. nefaka leh karna beeneh. veihu keman savar? ki ha deamar rame bar chama amar rabbi yitzchak: maamidin agardemin ben lammiddot ben lashshearim, mippene harammain.
Tanu rabbanan: haya mevakkesh mimmennu litra – shokel lo litra. chatzi litra – shokel lo chatzi litra. revia litra – shokel lo revia litra. may ka mashma lan? dimtakkeninan matkale ad hachi.
Tanu rabbanan: haya mevakkesh mimmennu shelosha rive litra, lo yomar lo: shekol li shelosha rive litra achat achat. ella shokel litra, umanniach revia litra im habbasar.
Tanu rabbanan: haya mevakkesh mimmennu eser litrin, lo yomar lo: shekol li achat achat vehacheriah; ella shokel lo kullan bevat achat, venoten hechrea echad lechullan.

Tanu rabbanan: nefesh moznayim – teluya baavir shelosha tefachim, ugevoha min haaretz shelosha tefachim, vekane umitna shellah shenem asar tefachim. veshel tzammarim veshel zaggagin – teluya baavir shene tefachim, ugevoha min haaretz shene tefachim, vekane umitna shellah tisha tefachim.

Veshel chenvoni veshel baal habbayit – teluya baavir tefach, ugevoha min haaretz tefach, vekane umitna shellah shishsha tefachim. veshel turetani – teluya baavir shalosh etzbaot, ugevoha min haaretz shalosh etzbaot, vekane umitna shellah eni yodea.
Veella hach kammayyta – demay?
b: Amar rav pappa: digarome.
Amar rabbi mani bar pattish: kederech sheamru leinyan issuran, kach amru leinyan tumeatan.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: chut moznayim shel chenvani veshel baale vattim – tefach! kane umitna shellah itztericha leh, dela tenan.
Tanu rabbanan: en osin mishkalot – lo shel baatz, velo shel avar, velo shel gisteron, velo shel shear mine mattachot. aval ose hu shel tzunema veshel zechuchit.
Tanu rabbanan: en osin hammechak shel delaat – mippene shehu kal, velo shel mattechet – mippene shehu machbid. aval osehu shel zayit veshel egoz, shel shikma veshel eshberoa.

Tanu rabbanan: en osin et hammechak tziddo echad av vetziddo echad katzar. lo yimchok bevat achat, shehammochek bevat achat – ra lammocher veyafe lallokeach; velo yimchok meat meat – shera lallokeach veyafe lammocher.

Al kullan amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay: oy li im omar, oy li im lo omar; im omar – shemma yilmedu harammain, veim lo omar – shemma yomru harammain: en talmide chachamim bekiin bemaase yadenu. ibbaya lehu: amra, o la amra? amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: amra – umehay kera amra: "ki yesharim darche Adonai, vetzaddikim yelchu vam, ufoshim yikkashlu vam".

Tanu rabbanan: "lo taasu avel bammishpat; bammidda, bammishkal uvammesura"; "bammidda" – zo medidat karka, shello yimdod leechad bimot hachamma uleechad bimot haggeshamim. "bammishkal" – shello yatmin mishkelotav bemelach. "bammesura" – shello yartiach.

Vekal vachomer – uma mesura, shehi echad mishsheloshim veshishsha ballog – hikpida alav tora; kal vachomer lehin, vachatzi hin, ushelishit hahin, ureviit hahin; velog, vachatzi log, ureviit, vachatzi tomen, veuchela.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: asur laadam sheyyashhe midda chasera o yetera betoch beto, vaafillu hi avit shel meme raglayim. amar rav pappa: la amaran ella beatra dela chatimi, aval beatra dachatimi – i la chaze chatima la shakel. uveatra dela chatimi name la amaran – ella dela mehanedsi, aval mehanedsi – let lan ba.

Vela hi; zimnin demikkere ben hashshemashot, umikkere veshakel. tanya name hachi: lo yashhe adam midda chasera o yetera betoch beto, vaafillu hi avit shel meme raglayim. aval ose hu sea, tarkav, vachatzi tarkav, vekav, vachatzi kav, verova, vetomen, vachatzi tomen,

a: Veuchela. vechamma hi uchela? echad mechamishsha birvia. uvemiddat hallach hu ose hin, vachatzi hin, ushelishit hahin, ureviit hahin, velog, vachatzi log, ureviit, usheminit, veechad mishshemona bishminit – vezehu kuretov.

Velebed name kabbayim! ate leichallofe betarkav. alma tau inashe tilta – i hachi, kav name la lebed; deate leichallofe bachatzi tarkav! ella kabbayim hayeynu tama dela aved – deate leichallofe bachatzi tarkav.
Alma tae inish riva – i hachi, chatzi tomen veuchela la lebed! amar rav pappa: middot ketannot bekii behu inashe.
Shelishit hahin, reviit hahin – la lebed! kevan dahavo bammikdash, la gezaru behu rabbanan. bammikdash name ligzor! kohanim zerizin hen.

Amar shemuel: en mosifin al hammiddot yoter mishshetut, velo al hammatbea yater mishshetut, vehammistakker al yishtakker yoter mishshetut. en mosifin al hammiddot yoter mishshetut – may tama? illema mishshum afkoe tara, shetut name la!
Ella mishshum onaa – dela leheve bittul mikkach? vehaamar rava: kol davar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan – afillu pachot mikkede onaa chozer!
Ella dela leheve peseda letaggara.
Peseda hu dela leheve leh – ravvcha la bae?! zevan vezabben – taggara ikkeri?!
Ella amar rav chisda: shemuel kera ashkach uderash – "vehashshekel – esrim gera; esrim shekalim, chamishsha veesrim shekalim, asara vachamishsha shekel – hammane yihye lachem".
b: Mane?! matan vearbein havu! ella shema minna telat: shema minna mane shel kodesh – kaful haya; ushema minna mosifin al hammiddot – veen mosifin yoter mishshetut; ushema minna shetuta – millevar.

Rav pappa bar shemuel takken keyayla bar telata kefize. amaru leh, veha amar shemuel: en mosifin al hammiddot yoter mishshetut! amar lehu: ana keyayla chadta takkeni. shaddereh lefumebdita – vela kabbelu, shaddereh lefappuneya – vekabbelu; vekaru leh: "ruz pappa".
(Siman: otzre ferot, en otzrin, veen motziin, veen mistakkerin paamayim bevetzim, matriin, velo motziin.)

Tanu rabbanan: otzre ferot, umalve beribbit, umaktine efa, umafkie shearim – alehen hakkatuv omer: "lemor matay yaavor hachodesh venashbira shever, vehashshabbat veniftecha bar, lehaketin efa ulehagdil shekel, uleavvet mozne mirma". uchetiv: "nishba Adonai bigon yaakov, im eshkach lanetzach kol maasehem".
Otzre ferot – kegon man? amar rabbi yochanan: kegon shabbetay atztzar perot.

Avu dishmuel mezabben lehu lefere betara charfa, ketara charfa. shemuel bereh, mashhe lefere, umezabben lehu betara afla – ketara charfa. shelachu mittam: tava deabba middivra. may tama? tara deravavch – ravavch.

Amar rav: ose adam et kabbo otzar. tanya name hachi: en otzrin perot – devarim sheyyesh bahen chayye nefesh, kegon: yenot, shemanin uselatot. aval tevalin, kammon ufilpelin – muttar. bamme devarim amurim – belokeach min hashshuk, aval bemachnis mishshello – muttar.
Umuttar laadam leetzor perot beeretz yisrael shalosh shanim – erev sheviit, usheviit, umotzae sheviit.

Uvishne vatztzoret – afillu kav charuvin lo yeetzor, mippene shemmachnis meera bashshearim. amar leh rabbi yose berabbi chanina lefuga shammaeh: puk etzar li pere shalosh shanim – erev sheviit, usheviit, umotzae sheviit.

Tanu rabbanan: en motziin perot meeretz yisrael – devarim sheyyesh bahen chayye nefesh, kegon: yenot, shemanim uselatot. rabbi yehuda ben betera mattir bayyayin, mippene shemmemaet et hattifla. ucheshem sheen motziin meeretz lechutz laaretz, kach en motziin meeretz yisrael lesureya. verabbi mattir

a: Mehipparcheya lehipparcheya.
Tanu rabbanan: en mistakkerim beeretz yisrael bidvarim sheyyesh bahen chayye nefesh, kegon: yenot, shemanim uselatot.
Amru alav al rabbi elazar ben azarya, shehaya mistakker beyayin vashemen. beyayin – savar la kerabbi yehuda; beshemen – beatreh derabbi elazar ben azarya shechiach mishcha.
Tanu rabbanan: en mistakkerin paamayim bevetzim. amar mari bar mari: peligi ba rav ushemuel; chad amar: al chad tere. vechad amar: taggar letaggara.
Tanu rabbanan: matriin al perakmatya, vaafillu beshabbat.
Amar rabbi yochanan: kegon kele fishtan bevavel, veyayin vashemen beeretz yisrael. amar rav yosef: vehu dezal vekam asra beshitta.

Tanu rabbanan: en yotzin mearetz lechutz laaretz, ella im ken amdu satayim besela. amar rabbi shimon: ematay – bizman sheeno motze likkach, aval bizman shemmotze likkach – afillu amda sea besela, lo yetze.

Vechen haya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: elimelech, machlon vechilyon, gedole haddor hayu, ufarnese haddor hayu; umippene ma neneshu? mippene sheyyatzu mearetz lechutza laaretz, shenneemar: "vattehom kol hair alehen, vattomarna hazot noomi". may "hazot noomi"? amar rabbi yitzchak, amru: chazitem noomi sheyyatzat mearetz lechutz laaretz – ma alta lah?
Veamar rabbi yitzchak: oto hayyom shebbat rut hammoaviyya leeretz yisrael, meta ishto shel boaz. vehayeynu deamri inashe: ad dela shachev shichva – kayyma menu vayyteh.

Amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav: ivtzan ze boaz. may ka mashma lan? ki iddach derabba bar rav huna – deamar rabba bar rav huna amar rav: mea veesrim mishtaot asa boaz levanav, shenneemar: "vayhi lo sheloshim banim, usheloshim banot shillach hachutza, usheloshim banot hevi levanav min hachutz, vayyishpot et yisrael sheva shanim".
Uvechol achat veachat asa shene mishtaot – echad bevet aviv, veechad bevet chamiv; uvechullan lo zimmen et manoach – amar: kudana akara, bemay para li?
Tana: vechullan metu bechayyav. vehayeynu deamri inashe: "bechayyich diladt shittin shittin – lema lich? ikkefal, veolid chad demishshittin zariz.

(Siman: malach, avraham, eser shanim, shenniftar, nitnasse levaddo.) amar rav chanan bar rava amar rav: elimelech, vesalmon, ufeloni almoni, vaavi noomi – kullan bene nachshon ben amminadav hen. may ka mashma lan? sheafillu mi sheyyesh lo zechut avot, enah omedet lo beshaa sheyyotze mearetz lechutza laaretz.
Veamar rav chanan bar rava amar rav: immeh deavraham – ammatlay bat karnevo. immeh dehaman – ammatlay bat orevti. vesimanaych: tame – tame, tahor – tahor.
Immeh dedavid – nitztzevet bat adel shemah. immeh deshimshon – tzelelponit, vaachateh nashyayn. lemay nafka minna? litshuvat hamminim.
Veamar rav chanan bar rava amar rav: eser shanim nechbash avraham avinu – shalosh bechuta, vesheva bekardu. verav dimi minnehardea matni ippecha. amar rav chisda: ivra zeera dechuta – zehu ur kasdim.
Veamar rav chanan bar rava amar rav: oto hayyom shenniftar avraham avinu min haolam, amdu kol gedole ummot haolam beshura; veamru: oy lo laolam sheavad
b: Manhigo, veoy lah lassefina sheavad kabbarnitah.
"Vehammitnasse lechol lerosh" – amar rav chanan bar rava amar rav: afillu resh garguta, mishshemayya mokmi leh.

Amar rav chiyyay bar avin amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: chas veshalom, sheafillu matzu subbin – lo yatzu. veella mippene ma neenshu? shehaya lahen levakkesh rachamim al doram, velo bikkeshu – shenneemar: "bezaakech yatztziluch kibbutzayich".
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella maot bezol, uferot beyoker; aval maot beyoker – afillu amdu arba sein besela, yotzin.

(Siman: sela, poel, charuva, talya, amrin.) deamar rabbi yochanan: nehirna kad havo kayymin arba sein besela; vahavo nefishi nefiche chefan bitverya, middelet issar. veamar rabbi yochanan: nehirna kad la havo mittagrin poalayya lemadnach karta; mereach pitta mayytin.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: nehirna kad hava batza yanoka charuva; vahava negid chuta deduvesha al teren deraohi. veamar rabbi elazar: nehirna kad hava natel orva bisra; unegid chuta demishcha meresh shura vead leara. veamar rabbi yochanan: nehirna kad havo metayyeylin talya vetalyeyta beshuka kevar shet esre uchevar shav esre, vela havo chatan. veamar rabbi yochanan: nehirna kad havo amrin be midresha: demode lehon – nafel bidehon; demitrechitz alehon – dileh dilhon.

Ketiv: "machlon vechilyon", uchetiv: "yoash vesaraf" – rav ushemuel; chad amar: "machlon" vechilyon" sheman, velamma nikra sheman "saraf" veyoash"? "yoash" – shennityaashu min haggeulla, "saraf" – shennitchayyeyvu serefa lammakom.
Vechad amar: "yoash" vesaraf" sheman, velamma nikra sheman "machlon" vechilyon"? "machlon" – sheasu gufan chullin, vechilyon" – shennitchayyeyvu kelaya lammakom.

Tanya keman deamar "machlon" vechilyon" sheman – detanya, may dichtiv: "veyokim, veanshe chozeva, veyoash, vesaraf – asher baalu lemoav; veyashuvi lachem; vehaddevarim attikim". "veyokim" – ze yehoshua, shehekim shevua leanshe givon. "veanshe chozeva" – ellu anshe givon, shekkizzevu bihoshua. "veyoash vesaraf" – ellu machlon vechilyon. velamma nikra sheman "yoash" vesaraf"? "yoash" – shennityaashu min haggeulla, "saraf" – shennitchayyeyvu serefa lammakom.

"Asher baalu lemoav" – shennasu nashim moaviyyot. "veyashuvi lachem" – zo rut hammoaviyya, sheshshava venidbeka bevet lechem yehuda. "vehaddevarim attikim" – devarim hallalu, attik yomayya amaran; dichtiv: "matzati david avdi", uchetiv: "shete venotecha hannimtzaot".
"Hemma hayyotzrim veyoshve netaim ugedera, im hammelech bimlachto yashvu sham"; "hemma hayyotzrim" – ellu bene yonadav ben rechav, shennatzru shevuat avihem.

"Yoshve netaim" – ze shelomo, sheddome lintia bemalchuto. "ugedera" – zo sanhedrin, sheggadru pirtzotehen shel yisrael. "im hammelech bimlachto yashvu sham" – zo rut hammoaviyya, sheraata bemalchut shelomo ben beno shel ben benah – shenneemar: "vayyasem kisse leem hammelech", veamar rabbi elazar: leimmah shel malchut.
Tanu rabbanan: "vaachaltem min hattevua yashan" – belo salmanton. may "belo salmanton"? rav nachman amar: bela retzinta. verav sheshet amar: bela shedifa.

Tanya kevateh derav sheshet, tanya kevateh derav nachman. tanya kevateh derav nachman: "vaachaltem yashan" – yachol yehu yisrael metzappin lechadash, mippene yashan shekkala? talmud lomar: "ad bo tevuatah" – ad shettavo tevua meeleha.
Tanya kevateh derav sheshet: "vaachaltem min hattevua yashan" – yachol yehu yisrael metzappin lechadash mippene yashan shera? talmud lomar: "ad bo tevuatah" – ad shettavo tevua meeleha.

Tanu rabbanan: "vaachaltem yashan noshan" – melammed shekkol hameyushshan mechavero, have yafe mechavero. veen li ella devarim sheddarkan leyayshshenan; devarim sheen darkan leyayshshenan – minnayin? talmud lomar: "yashan noshan" mikkol makom.

"Veyashan mippene chadash totziu" – melammed shehayu otzarot melein yashan vogoranot melein chadash, vehayu yisrael omrim: heach notzi ze mippene ze? amar rav pappa: kol mille attika – mealleya, levar mittamre, veshichra, veharesana.
Hadaran alach hammocher et hassefina

a: Hammocher perot lachavero, uzeraan velo tzimmechu; vaafillu zera pishtan – eno chayyayv beachrayutan. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: zerone ginna sheenan neechalin, chayyayv beachrayutan.
Gemara ittemar: hammocher shor lachavero venimtza nagchan, rav amar: hare ze mikkach taut; ushemuel amar, yachol lomar lo: lishchita mechartiv lach.
Velichze; i gavra dezaven lenichseta – lenichseta, i leridya – leridya! begavra dezaven lehachi ulehachi.
Velichze deme hechi ninhu!
La tzericha; deiyyaykkar bisra, vekam bidme ridya. i hachi, lemay nafka minna? nafka minna letircha.
Hechi dame?
b: I delekka leishtallome minneh, liakkav tora bezuzeh! deamri inashe: min mare reshutaych – pare ippera!
La tzericha, deikka leishtallome minneh.
Rav amar: hare ze mikkach taut – batar rubba azlinan, verubba leridya zavni. ushemuel amar lach: ki azlinan batar rubba – beissura, bemamona – la.
(Siman: ishsha, veeved, shor, shevarin, uferot.)
Metivi: haishsha shennitalmena o nitgarsha; vehi omeret: betula nisseti, vehu omer: lo chi, ella almana nesatich – im yesh edim sheyyatza behinuma, veroshah parua – ketubbatah matayim.
Tama deikka edim, ha lekka edim – la; veammay? lema: hallech achar rov hannashim, verov nashim – betulot nissaot!
Amar ravina, mishshum deikka lememar: rov nashim betulot nissaot, umiut almanot; vechol hannisset betula – yesh lah kol; vezo, hoil veen lah kol – ittera le rubba.
I kol hannissaot betulot yesh lahen kol, ki ikka edim may have? middelet la kol – sahadi shakkare ninhu!
Ella rov hannissaot betulot yesh lahen kol, vezo, hoil veen lah kol – ittera le rubba.
Ta shema: hammocher eved lachavero venimtza gannav o kuveyusetus, higgio. listim mezuyyayn o muchetav lammalchut – omer lo: hare shellecha lefanecha.
Resha –

a: May tama? lav mishshum derubba hachi itanhu?
La, kullehu hachi itanhu.
Ta shema: shor shennagach et happara, venimtza ubbarah betziddah, veeno yadua im ad shello negachah yalda, o im mishshennegachah yalda – meshallem chatzi nezek lappara, urevia lavvalad.
Veammay? lema: hallech achar rov parot, verov parot mitabberot veyoldot; veha vadday mechamat negicha hippila!

Hatam, mishshum dimsappeka lan, deikka lememar: mikkamma ata, umibbiatuta hippila; veikka lememar: meachora ata, umingach nagcha vehippila; have mamon hammuttal besafek, vechol mamon hammuttal besafek – cholkin.

Lema ketannae: shor shehaya roe, venimtza shor harug betziddo; af al pi shezze menuggach veze muad liggach, ze menushshach veze muad lishshoch; en omrim: beyadua shezze negacho veze neshacho. rabbi acha omer: gamal haocher ben haggemallim, venimtza gamal harug betziddo – beyadua shezze harago.
Savruha derubba vachazaka ki hadade ninhu; lema rav deamar kerabbi acha, ushemuel deamar ketanna kamma?
Amar lecha rav: ana daamari afillu letanna kamma; ad kan la kaamar tanna kamma hatam – ella dela azlinan batar chazaka, aval batar rubba – azlinan.
Ushemuel amar lach: ana daamari afillu lerabbi acha; ad kan la kaamar rabbi acha hatam – ella deazlinan batar chazaka, dehu gufeh muchezak; aval batar rubba – la azlinan.
Ta shema: hammocher perot lachavero, uzeraan velo tzimmechu; vaafillu zera pishtan – eno chayyayv beachrayutan.
May "afillu"? lav afillu zera pishtan, derubba lizria zavni, vaafillu hachi la azlinan batar rubba?
Tannae hi, detanya: hammocher perot lachavero uzeraan velo tzimmechu; zerone ginna sheen neechalin – chayyayv beachrayutan, zera pishtan – eno chayyayv beachrayutan. rabbi yose omer:
b: Noten lo deme zera. amru lo: harebe lokchin oto lidvarim acherim.
Man tannae? illema rabbi yose veamru lo"; tarvayyhu batar rubba azli – mar azel batar rubba deinashe, umar azel batar rubba dizria!
Ella i tanna kamma verabbi yose, i tanna kamma veamru lo".
Tanu rabbanan: mahu noten lo? deme zera, velo hotzaa. veyesh omrim: af hotzaa.
Man yesh omrim? amar rav chisda: rabban shimon ben gamliel hi.

He rabban shimon ben gamliel? illema rabban shimon ben gamliel dematnitin – ditnan: hammocher perot lachavero uzeraan velo tzimmechu, vaafillu zera pishtan – eno chayyayv beachrayutan. ha zerone ginna sheenan neechalin – chayyayv beachrayutan.

Ema sefa, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: zerone ginna sheenan neechalin – chayyayv beachrayutan. tanna kamma name hachi kaamar – zera pishtan hu deeno chayyayv beachrayutan, ha zerone ginna sheenan neechalin – chayyayv beachrayutan!
Ella lav hotzaa ikka benayyhu – mar savar deme zera, umar savar af hotzaa?
Mimmay? dilma ippecha! ha la kashya; kol tanna batra, letappoye milleta ka ate.

Vedilma kullah rabban shimon ben gamliel hi – vechassore mechassera, vehachi katane: hammocher perot lachavero uzeraan velo tzimmechu, afillu zera pishtan – eno chayyayv beachrayutan, ha zerone ginna sheenan neechalin – chayyayv beachrayutan; divre rabban shimon ben gamliel; sherabban shimon ben gamliel omer: zera pishtan hu deeno chayyayv beachrayutan, ha zerone ginna sheenan neechalin – chayyayv beachrayutan.

Ella ha rabban shimon ben gamliel – detanya: hammolich chittin lattachon, velo letatan – vaasaan subbin o muresan; kemach lannachtom, vaafao pat nippulin; behema lattabbach, venibbelah – chayyayv, mippene shehu kenose sachar.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: noten lo deme voshto, udeme boshet orchav. vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: minhag gadol haya birushalayim – hammoser seuda lachavero, vekilkelah; noten lo deme voshto udeme boshet orchav.
Od minhag gadol haya birushalayim – mappa perusa al gabbe happetach; kol zeman shemmappa perusa – orchin nichnasin. nistalleka hammappa – en haorchin nichnasin.

Mishna hammocher perot lachavero, hare ze mekabbel alav rova tinnofet lisa. teenim – mekabbel alav eser metullaot lemea. martef shel yayin – mekabbel alav eser kossot lemea. kankannim bashsharon – mekabbel alav eser pitasot lemea.
Gemara tane rav kattina: rova kitnit lisa. veafrurit la?! vehaamar rabba bar chiyyay ketosfaa mishshemeh derabba: borer tzeror miggorno shel chavero –

a: Noten lo deme chittin!
Kitnit – rova, afrurit – pachot merova.
Veafrurit – rova la?! veha tanya: hammocher perot lachavero, chittin – mekabbel alav rova kitnit lisa. seorim – mekabbel alav rova nishshovet lisa. adashim – mekabbel alav rova afrurit lisa.
May, lav hu haddin lechittim velisorin? shane adashim, demikar akri lehu.
Ella tama daadashim demikar akri lehu, aval chitte useare – la; tifshot minna, chitte useare deafrurit la mekabbel!
Leolam chitte useare mekabbel afrurit; adashim itztericha leh – desalka datach amena: kevan demikar akri lehu, yoter merova name lekabbel, ka mashma lan.
Amar rav huna: im ba lenappot, menappe et kullo. amri la dina, veamri la kinsa.
Amri la dina – man deyahev zuze, appere shappire yahev; verova la tarach inish, yoter merova tarach inish; vechevan detarach – tarach bechulleh.
Veamri la kinsa – rova shechiach, yoter la shechiach; veihu hu dearev; vechevan dearev – kansuhu rabbanan bechulleh.
(Siman: kol tere shetare deravin bar rav nachman, onaa vekabbelanuta.)
Metivi: kol sea sheyyesh bah rova mimmin acher – yemaet. savruha derova dechilayim – keyoter merova dehacha, veka tane: yemaet!
Lo, rova dechilayim – ki rova dehacha dame.
I hachi, ammay yemaet? mishshum chumera dechilayim.
I hachi,
b: Ema sefa – rabbi yose omer: yavor.
I amrat bishlama keyoter merova tinnofet dame, beha ka mippalgi – tanna kamma savar: la kansinan hettera attu issura, verabbi yose savar: kansinan. ella i amrat kerova dame, ammay yavor?
Hatam hayeynu tama derabbi yose – mishshum demichaze ki mekayyem kilayim.
Ta shema: shenayim shehifkidu etzel echad, ze mane veze matayim; ze omer: "matayim shelli", veze omer: "matayim shelli" – noten laze mane velaze mane, vehashshear yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam, vadday mane lemar umane lemar; hacha, mi yemar delav kulleh arove arev?
Ta shema missefa – amar rabbi yose: im ken, ma hifsid harammay? ella hakkol yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu.
Hachi hasheta?! hatam vadday ikka rammay, hacha mi yemar dearove arev.
Ta shema: shetar sheyyesh bo ribbit – konsin oto, veeno gove lo et hakkeren velo et haribbit; divre rabbi meir!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam mishsheat ketiva hu daavad leh suma, hacha mi yemar dearove arev.
Ta shema missefa – vachachamim omrim: gove et hakkeren, veeno gove et haribbit!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam vadday karna dehettera hu, hacha mi yemar dechulleh la arove arev.
Ta shema, detane ravin bar rav nachman: lo et hammotar bilvad hu machazir, ella machazir lo et kol harvain kullan. alma hecha devae ahdore – kulla mahdar!
Hachi hasheta?!

a: Hatam, "hen chaser hen yater" amar leh, mihu revia la chashiv; yater mervia – chashiv,
Dechevan dachaze leh leitzterofe betishat kabbin, havya la ara chashivta beappe nafsha; vehadra.
Ta shema: haonaa; pachot mishshetut – nikne mikkach, yoter mishshetut – batel mikkach. shetut – kana, umachzir onaa.
Ammay? layhdar ad pachot mishshetut! shema minna, kol hechi devae leahdore – kulla mahdar!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam, meikkara shave beshave amar leh, mihu, pachot mishshetut la yedia bemane, umachel inish; shetut – yedia, vela machel inish, yater mishshetut – mikkach taut hu, uvatel mikkach.
Ta shema: hamekabbel sade mechavero litta – hare ze mekabbel alav eser boriyyot lemea. yoter mikkan – megalgelin alav et hakkol.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: kol yater mikkan, keva litta mittechilla dame.
Martef shel yayin vechulei. hechi dame? i deamar leh: "martef shel yayin" setam – kashya; i deamar leh: "martef ze shel yayin" – kashya.

I deamar leh: "martef ze" – kashya, detanya: "martef shel yayin ani mocher lach" – noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe. "martef ze shel yayin ani mocher lach" – noten lo yayin hannimkar bachanut. "martef ze ani mocher lach" – afillu kullo chometz, higgio!
Leolam deamar leh "martef shel yayin" – setam, vetane beresha devarayyta: umekabbel alav eser kossot lemea.
Uvistam mi mekabbel?! veha tane rabbi chiyyay: hammocher chavit yayin lachavero – noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe! shane chavit, dechulla chad chamra hu.

Veha tane rav zevid deve rabbi oshaya: "martef shel yayin ani mocher lach" – noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe. "martef ze shel yayin ani mocher lach" – noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe, umekabbel alav eser kossot lemea,
b: Vezehu otzar sheshshanu chachamim bemishnatenu!
Ella matnitin name deamar leh "ze".
Kashya "ze" azze"!
La kashya; ha deamar leh lemikpa, ha dela amar leh lemikpa. derav zevid – deamar leh lemikpa, barayyta – dela amar leh lemikpa.

Hilkach, "martef shel yayin" veamar lo lemikpa – noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe. "martef ze shel yayin" veamar leh lemikpa – noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe, umekabbel alav eser kossot lemea. "martef ze shel yayin" vela amar leh lemikpa – noten lo yayin hannimkar bachanut.
Ibbaya lehu: "martef shel yayin" vela amar leh lemikpa, may? peligi ba rav acha veravina; chad amar: mekabbel, vechad amar: la mekabbel.

Man deamar mekabbel – dayek midderav zevid, dekatane: "martef shel yayin ani mocher lach" – noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe, veokimna deamar leh lemikpa; tama deamar leh lemikpa, ha la amar leh lemikpa – mekabbel.
Uman deamar la mekabbel – dayek mibbarayyta, dekatane: "martef shel yayin ani mocher lach" – noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe, veokemna dela amar leh lemikpa.

Uleman dedayek midderav zevid, kashya barayyta! chassore mechassera, vehachi katane: bamme devarim amurim – deamar leh lemikpa; ha la amar leh lemikpa – mekabbel. umartef ze shel yayin" vela amar leh lemikpa – noten lo yayin hannimkar bachanut.
Uleman dedayek mibbarayyta, kashya derav zevid – deokemna deamar leh lemikpa, ha la amar leh lemikpa – mekabbel!
Hu haddin deaf al gav dela amar leh lemikpa – la mekabbel, vehay deokemna deamar leh lemikpa, mishshum dekashya "ze" azze".
Amar rav yehuda: yayin hannimkar bachanut – mevarchin alav "bore peri haggefen". verav chisda amar: gabbe chamra deakrem lema li?
Metivi: al happat sheippesha, veal hayyayin shehikrim, veal tavshil sheibbera tzurato – omer "shehakkol nihye bidvaro"!
Amar rav zevid: mode rav yehuda befuretzma demizdabban akkarnata.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ha rav yehuda, ha rav chisda; mar keman sevira leh? amar leh: matnita yadana.

a: Detanya: habbodek et hechavit lihyot mafrish aleha teruma veholech, veachar kach nimtzet chometz; kol shelosha yom – vadday, mikkan veelach – safek.
May kaamar? amar rabbi yochanan, hachi kaamar: kol shelosha yamim harishonim – vadday yayin, mikkan veelach – safek.
May tama? chamra – meillay akar, vehay taaymeh vela akar. im timtza lomar: batar detaaymeh akar; have recha challa vetameh chamra, vechol recheh challa vetameh chamra – chamra.
Verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: kol shelosha yamim haacharonim – vadday chometz. mikkan ulehallan – safek.

May tama? chamra mittattay akar, veemor akar velav addateh. veim timtza lomar meillay akar, veha taaymeh vela akar; dilma batar detaaymeh akar – have recheh challa vetameh chamra, verecheh challa vetameh chamra – challa.
Daromae matnu mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: rishonim – vadday yayin, acharonim – vadday chometz, emtzaiyyim – safek.
Ha gufa kashya – amrat: rishonim vadday yayin, alma recheh challa vetameh chamra – chamra; vahadar amrat: acharonim vadday chometz, alma recheh challa vetameh chamra – challa!
Kegon deishtechach challa sifteka, dei lav daakar telata yome – la hava mishtechach challa sifteka.
Keman peshat leh? peligi ba rav mari verav zevid; chad amar: kerabbi yochanan, vechad amar: kerabbi yehoshua ben levi.
Ittemar: hammocher chavit yayin lachavero, vehechmitza – amar rav: kol shelosha yamim harishonim birshut mocher, mikkan veelach birshut lokeach.
b: Ushemuel amar: chamra – akkatpa demareh shavavr.
Avad rav yosef ovada kevoteh derav beshichra, uchevoteh dishmuel bechamra. vehilcheta kevoteh dishmuel.

Tanu rabbanan: echad shechar temarim, veechad shechar seorim, veechad shimre yayin – mevarchin alehem "shehakkol nihye bidvaro". acherim omrim: shemarim sheyyesh bahem taam yayin, mevarech alehen "bore peri haggefen". rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: en halacha kaacherim.
Amar rava: dechulle alma, rema telata vaata arbea – chamra hu. rava letameh, deamar rava: kol chamra dela dare al chad telat mayya – lav chamra hu.
Rema telata vaata telata, vela kelum hu. ki peligi, dirma telata vaata telata ufalga – derabbanan savri: telata ayel telata nafek, pash leh palga – ufalga beshitta palge mayya, vela kelum hu;
Vaacherim savri: telata ul, teren ufalga nafek, pash leh kuza; vechuza bitre ufalga chamra, mealleya hu.
Uveyoter mikkede middato, mi peligi?! veha tenan:

a: Hametammed, venatan mayim bemidda, umatza kede middato – patur, verabbi yehuda mechayyev. ad kan la peligi ella bichde middato, aval beyoter mikkede middato – la peligi!
Hu haddin daafillu beyoter mikkede middato peligi; vehay deka mippalgi bichde middato, lehodiacha kocho derabbi yehuda.
Bea minneh rav nachman bar yitzchak merav chiyyay bar avin: shemarim sheyyesh bahen taam yayin, mahu? amar leh: mi savrat chamra hu? kiyyuha bealma hu.
Tanu rabbanan: shemarim shel teruma – rishon vesheni asur, ushelishi muttar. rabbi meir omer: af shelishi, benoten taam.
Veshel maaser – rishon asur, sheni muttar. rabbi meir omer: af sheni, benoten taam. veshel hekdesh – shelishi asur, urevii muttar. rabbi meir omer: af revii, benoten taam.
Ureminhi: shel hekdesh – leolam asur, veshel maaser – leolam muttar. kashya hekdesh ahekdesh, kashya maaser ammaaser!
Hekdesh ahekdesh la kashya – kan bikdushshat hagguf, kan bikdushshat damim. maaser ammaaser name la kashya – kan bemaaser vadday, kan bemaaser demay.
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: kederech sheamru leinyan issuran, kach amru leinyan hechsheran.
Hechsheran demay? i demayya – achshore machsheri! i dechamra – achshore machsheri! la tzericha, shettimmedo beme geshamim.
Vechevan deka shakel verame lehu lemana – achshevinhu! la tzericha, shennittammed meelav.
Vechevan deka naged – kamma kamma achshevinhu! amar rav pappa: befara sheshshota rishon rishon.
Amar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: en omrim kiddush hayyom, ella al hayyayin harauy linnasech al gabbe hammizbeach.
Lemaote may? illema lemaote yayin miggitto, veha tane rabbi chiyyay: yayin miggitto lo yavi, veim hevi – kasher; vechevan deim hevi kasher, anan afillu lechattechilla name!
b: Deamar rava: sochet adam eshkol shel anavim, veomer alav kiddush hayyom!
Veella lemaote mippiha umishshuleha? veha tane rabbi chiyyay: mippiha umishshuleha lo yavi, veim hevi – kasher!
Veella lemaote yayin kushi; borek; heliston; shel martef; shel tzimmukim? veha tanya: bechullan lo yavi, veim hevi – kasher!
Veella lemaote yayin koses; mazug; megulle; veshel shemarim; vesherecho ra – detanya: bechullan lo yavi, veim hevi – pasul.
Lemaote may? i lemaote koses, pelugeta derabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi hi!
I lemaote mazug, alloye alleyeh – deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: modim chachamim lerabbi eliezer bechos shel beracha, sheen mevarchin alav ad sheyyitten letocho mayim!
I lemaote megulle, sakkana hi!
I lemaote shel shemarim, hechi dame? i dirma telata vaata arbea, chamra mealleya hu! i dirma telata vaata telata ufalga, pelugeta derabbanan vaacherim hi!
Ella lemaote sherecho ra. veibbaet ema: leolam lemaote megulle – veaf al gav deabbereh bimsannenet kerabbi nechemya, afillu hachi – "hakerivehu na lefechatecha hayirtzecha o hayissa fanecha".
Bea minneh rav kahana chamu derav mesharsheya merava: chamar chivvavryayn, mahu? amar leh: "al tere yayin ki yitaddam".
Kankannim bashsharon vechulei. tana: pitasot naot umegupparot.
Mishna hammocher yayin lachavero, vehechmitz – eno chayyayv beachrayuto. veim yadua sheyyeno machmitz – hare ze mikkach taut. veim amar lo: "yayin

a: Mevussam ani mocher lach" – chayyayv lehaamid lo ad haatzeret. veyashan" – mishshel eshtakad, umeyushshan" – mishshel shalosh shanim.
Gemara amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: lo shanu ella bekankannim delokeach, aval bekankannim democher – amar leh: ha chamrach veha kankannach.
Vechi kankannin democher may have? lema leh: la ibbei lach leshahoye! la tzericha, daamar leh lemikpa.
Umay duchekeh derabbi yose berabbi chanina leokoma lematnitin bekankannin delokeach – vedaamar leh lemikpa? lokmeah bekankennin democher, udela amar leh lemikpa!
Amar rava: matnitin keshiteh, dekatane: im yadua sheyyeno machmitz – hare ze mikkach taut. ammay? lema leh: la ibbei lach leshahoye! ella lav shema minna daamar leh lemikpa? shema minna.
Ufeliga derav chiyyay bar yosef – deamar rav chiyyay bar yosef: chamra – mazzala demareh garem, shenneemar: "veaf ki hayyayin boged, gever yahir vegomer"
Amar rav mari: hay man dihir – afillu ainashe veteh la mikkabbal, shenneemar: "gever yahir velo yinve" – may "velo yinve"? bannave shello.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hammitgae betallit shel talmid chacham, veeno talmid chacham – en machnisin oto bimchitzato shel hakkadosh baruch hu. ketiv hacha: "velo yinve", uchetiv hatam: "el neve kodshecha".

Amar rava: hay man dezabben leh chavita dechamra lechanvaa addata lesabboyeh, utekef appalga o attilleta, dina hu dimkabbel la minneh. vela amaran ella dela shanni bevarza, aval shanni bevarza – la. vela amaran ella dela meta yoma deshuka, aval meta yoma deshuka – la.
Veamar rava: hay man dekabbel chamra addata demamte leh lefarvota devol shafat", veaddemate hatam zal; dina hu dimkabbel leh.
Ibbaya lehu: hava challa, may? amar leh rav hillel lerav ashe: ki havan be rav kahana, amar lan: challa la, udela kerabbi yose berabbi chanina.
Veikka deamri: afillu challa name mekabbel. keman? kerabbi yose berabbi chanina.
"Yashan" – mishshel eshtakad kulei.
b: Tana: umeyayshshen veholech ad hachag.

Mishna hammocher makom lachavero, vechen hamekabbel makom mechavero laasot lo bet chatnut livno uvet almenut levitto – bone arba ammot al shesh, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yishmael omer: refet bakar hi zo!
Harotze laasot refet bakar – bone arba ammot al shesh.
Bayit katan – shesh al shemone, gadol – shemone al eser, teraklin – eser al eser. rumo kachatzi orko vechachatzi rochbo. reaya laddavar – rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kevinyan hahechol.

Gemara lema li lemitna "bet chatnut livno, uvet almenut levitto"? litne "bet chatnut livno ulevitto, uvet almenut livno ulevitto"! milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan, dela darka dechatna lemedar be chamu –

Kedichtiv besefer ben sira: hakkol shakalti bechaf moznayim, velo matzati kal missubbin; vekal missubbin – chatan haddar bevet chamiv; vekal mechatan – oreach machnis oreach; vekal meoreach – meshiv davar beterem yishma – shenneemar: "meshiv davar beterem yishma ivvelet hi lo uchelimma".
Rabbi yishmael omer: refet bakar hi zo! harotze laasot kulei. refet bakar man katane la? ikka deamar rabbi yishmael katane la, veikka deamar rabbi akiva katane la.

Ikka deamar rabbi akiva katane la – vehachi kaamar: af al pi sherefet bakar hi, peamim sheadam ose dirato kerefet bakar. veikka deamar rabbi yishmael katane la – vehachi kaamar: sheharotze laasot refet bakar, ose arba ammot al shesh.
Teraklin eser al eser. may teraklin? kubbeta be vavrde.
Tane: vekanter – shetem esre al shetem esre. may kanter? tarbetz appadne.

Rumo kachatzi orko vechachatzi rochbo, reaya laddavar – rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kevinyan hahechol. "reaya laddavar" man katane la? ikka deamar rabban shimon ben gamliel katane la – vehachi kaamar: reaya laddavar minnayin? amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: hakkol kevinyan hechol.
Veikka deamar tanna kamma katane la – verabban shimon ben gamliel atmohe ka matma, vehachi kaamar leh [letanna kamma]: reaya minnayin – mibbinyan hechol?! attu kulle alma kevinyan hechol avdi?
Tanya, acherim omrim: rumo – kekorotav. velema: rumo kerochbo! ibbaet ema: beta meillay ravavch, veibbaet ema: mishshum deikka be chavvevy.

Rabbi chanina nefak lekiryayta, remo leh kerae ahadade – ketiv: "vehabbayit asher bana hammelech shelomo laAdonai – shishshim amma orko, veesrim rochbo, usheloshim amma komato"; uchetiv: "velifne haddevir – esrim amma orech, veesrim amma rochav, veesrim amma komato"! amar lehu: ki ka chashev – missefat keruvim ulemala.
May ka mashma lan?

a: Ha ka mashma lan – lematta kilmala; ma lemala en meshammesh kelum, af lematta en meshammesh kelum.

Mesayyay leh lerabbi levi – deamar rabbi levi, veittema rabbi yochanan: davar ze masoret beyadenu meavotenu – mekom aron ucheruvim eno min hammidda. tanya name hachi: aron sheasa moshe, yesh lo revach eser ammot lechol ruach veruach.

Amar ravnay amar shemuel: keruvim – benes hen omdin, shenneemar: "vechamesh ammot kenaf hakkeruv haechat, vechamesh ammot kenaf hakkeruv hashshenit, eser ammot miktzot kenafav vead ketzot kenafav". gufayyhu hecha havo kayymi? ella shema minna: benes hen omdin.
Matkef la abbaye: vedilma boltin ketarnegolin havo kayymi! matkef la rava: vedilma ze shello keneged ze havo kayymi! matkef la rav acha bar yaakov: vedilma baalachsona havo kayymi!
Matkef la rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: vedilma beta meillay ravavch! matkef la rav pappa: vedilma mikkaf havo kayyfi yedayyhu! matkef la rav ashe: vedilma shalchofe havo meshalchafi!

Ketzad hen omdin? rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar; chad amar: penehem ish el achiv, vechad amar: penehem labbayit. uleman deamar penehem ish el achiv, ha ketiv: "ufenehem labbayit"! la kashya; kan bizman sheyyisrael osin retzono shel makom, kan bizman sheen yisrael osin retzono shel makom.

Uleman deamar "ufenehem labbayit", ha ketiv: "ufenehem ish el achiv"! dimtzaddedi atzdode – detanya, uneklos hagger amar: keruvim – "maase tzaatzuim" hen, umetzoddim penehem ketalmid hanniftar merabbo.

Mishna mi sheyyesh lo bor lifnim mibbeto shel chavero – nichnas beshaa shedderech bene adam nichnasin, veyotze beshaa shedderech bene adam yotzin. veeno machnis behemto umashkah mibboro, ella memalle umashkah mibbachutz. veze ose lo potachat, veze ose lo potachat.
Gemara potachat lehecha? amar rabbi yochanan: shenehem labbor. bishlama baal habbor, bae leishtammore mayya devoreh; ella baal habbayit – lema leh? amar rabbi elazar:
b: Mishshum chashad ishto.

Mishna mi sheyyesh lo ginna lifnim migginnato shel chavero – nichnas beshaa shedderech bene adam nichnasim, veyotze beshaa shedderech bene adam yotzin; veeno machnis letochah taggarin; velo yikkanes mittochah letoch sade acheret; vehachitzon zorea et hadderech.

Natnu lo derech min hatztzad middaat shenehen – nichnas beshaa shehu rotze, veyotze beshaa sherotze; umachnis letochah taggarin. velo yikkanes mittochah letoch sade acheret. ze vaze enan rashshaim lezorah.

Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: "amma bet hashshelachin ani mocher lach" – noten lo shete ammot letochah, veamma mikkan veamma mikkan laagappeha. "amma bet hakkilon ani mocher lach" – noten lo amma achat letochah, vachatzi amma mikkan vachatzi amma mikkan laagappeha.

Veotan agappayim – mi zoram? rav yehuda amar shemuel: baal hassade zoram, rav nachman amar shemuel: baal hassade notam. man deamar zoram – kol shekken notam. uman deamar notam – aval zoram la, chalchole mechalchali.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: ammat hammayim shekkalu agappeha – metakkenah meota sade; beyadua shello kalu agappeha ella beotah sade.
Matkef la rav pappa, velema leh: mayyaych ashpeluha learaych! ella amar rav pappa: sheal menat ken kibbel alav baal hassade.
Mishna mi shehayta derech harabbim overet letoch sadehu; netalah venatan lahem min hatztzad – ma shennatan natan, veshello lo higgio.
Derech hayyachid – arba ammot. derech harabbim – shesh esre amma. derech hammelech – en lah shiur. derech hakkever – en lah shiur. hammaamad – dayyayne tzippori amru: bet arbaa kabbin.
Gemara ammay shello lo higgio? linkot pazra velittev! shamat minna la aved inish dina lenafsheh – afillu bimkom peseda?
Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: gezera shemma yitten lahen derech akallaton. rav mesharsheya mishshemeh derava amar: benoten lahem derech akallaton.

a: Rav ashe amar: kol min hatztzad – derech akallaton hi; kerova laze, urechoka laze.
Velema lehu: shiklu didchu vehavu li didi! ha manni – rabbi eliezer hi. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: rabbim shebberru derech leatzmam, ma shebberru berru.
Lerabbi eliezer – rabbim gazlanim ninhu?! amar rav giddel amar rav: kegon sheavda lahen derech beotah sade.
I hachi, ammay amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav: en halacha kerabbi eliezer? man dematne ha la matne ha.
Vetama may? mishshum derav yehuda – deamar rav yehuda: metzer shehecheziku bo rabbim – asur lekalkelo.
Verabbi eliezer – rabbim bemay kanu leh? behillucha. detanya: hillech bah leorkah ulerochbah – kana mekom hillucho, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: en hilluch moil kelum, ad sheyyachzik.

Amar rabbi elazar, may tama derabbi eliezer? dichtiv: "kum hithallech baaretz leorkah ulerochbah, ki lecha ettenenna". verabbanan – hatam mishshum chabbivuta deavraham hu dekaamar leh hachi, kede sheyyehe noach lichbosh lifne vanav.
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: modim chachamim lerabbi eliezer bishvil shel keramim, hoil venaasa lehilluch – nikne behilluch.

Ki ato lekammeh derav yitzchak bar amme, amar lehu: havu leh ki hechi dedare tuna dishvishata vehadar. vela amaran ella dimsayyeymin mechitzata, aval la mesayyeymin mechitzata – ki hechi deshakel kara umannach kara.

Derech hayyachid arba ammot. tana, acherim omrim: kede sheyyaavor chamor bemassao. amar rav huna: halacha kaacherim. vetanya iddach, dayyayne gola omrim: shene gammadim umechetza. veamar rav huna: halacha kedayyayne gola. vehaamar rav huna: halacha kaacherim! idde veidde chad shiura hu.
Derech harabbim shesh esre amma. tanu rabbanan: derech hayyachid – arba ammot. derech meir leir – shemone ammot.
b: Derech harabbim – shesh esre ammot. derech are miklat – sheloshim ushetayim ammot. amar rav huna: may keraa? dichtiv: "tachin lecha hadderech" – "derech–hadderech".
Derech hammelech en lah shiur. shehammelech poretz gader laasot lo derech, veen memachin beyado.
Derech hakkever en lah shiur. mishshum yekara deshachva.

Hammaamad – dayyayne tzippori amru: bet arba kabbin kulei. tanu rabbanan: hammocher kivro, derech kivro, mekom maamado uvet hespedo – bain bene mishpacha vekovrin oto al korcho, mishshum pegam mishpacha.
Tanu rabbanan: en pochatin mishshiva maamadot umoshavot lemet, keneged "havel havalim amar kohelet, havel havalim hakkol havel".

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: hechi avdi? amar leh: kidtanya, amar rabbi yehuda: bihuda, barishona lo hayu pochatin mishshiva maamadot umoshavot lemet, kegon: "imdu yekarim amodu"; "shevu yekarim shevu". amru lo: im ken, af beshabbat muttar laasot ken.

Achateh derame bar pappa hava nesiva leh lerav avya. shechiva, avad la maamad umoshav. amar rav yosef: tea betarte; tea – sheen osin ella bikrovim, vehu avad afillu birchokim; utea – sheen osin ella beyom rishon, vehu avad beyom sheni.
Abbaye amar: beha name tea – sheen osin ella bevet hakkevarot, vehu asa bair. rava amar: beha name tea – sheen osin ella bimkom shennahagu, vehatam la nehug.
Metivi, amru lo: im ken, af beshabbat muttar laasot ken. vei amrat bevet hakkevarot uveyom rishon, bet hakkevarot beshabbat may bae? beir hassemucha levet hakkevarot, deamteyuhu ben hashshemashot.

Mishna hammocher makom lachavero laasot lo kever, vechen hamekabbel mechavero laasot lo kever – ose tochah shel meara arba ammot al shesh. ufoteach letochah shemona kuchin – shalosh mikkan veshalosh mikkan, ushenayim mikkenegdan. vechuchin – orkan arba ammot, veruman sheva,

a: Verochban shishsha.

Rabbi shimon omer: ose tochah shel meara shesh ammot al shemone, ufoteach letochah shelosha asar kuch – arbaa mikkan, vearbaa mikkan, ushelosha mikkenegdan, veechad mimin happetach, veechad min hassemol.
Veose chatzer al pi hammeara shesh al shesh, kimlo hammitta vekovreha.
Ufoteach letochah shete mearot – achat mikkan veachat mikkan. rabbi shimon omer: arba learba ruchoteha.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hakkol lefi hassela.
Gemara hane tere lehecha shade lehu? i levaray – ha kamittadshi lehu! vetu, ha tenan: chatzar hakkever, haomed betocho – tahor!
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: deaved lehu kemin neger.
Veha amar rabbi yochanan:
b: Kevurat chamorim hi zo!
Lerabbi yochanan, deaved lehu bekeren zavit.
Veha nagi kuchin lahadade!
Amar rav ashe: bemaamik. dei la tema hachi, arba mearot lerabbi shimon – hechi aved lehu? ha ka nagi kuchin lahadade! ella bemaamik; hacha name bemaamik.
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: arba mearot lerabbi shimon – deaved lehu ki charuta.

Veha derav huna bereh derav yehoshua – beruta hi. mikkede kol ammeta beribbua ammeta utere chumeshe baalachsona; kamma have lehu? chad sere vechumesha; kuchin kamma havu? temanya; temanya bechad sere vechumesha hechi mashkachat la? ella ha derav huna bereh derav yehoshua – beruta hi.
Vei baet ema, kidamar rav shisha bereh derav idi: benifle; hacha name benifle.
Tenan hatam: hammotze met mushekav kedarko, notlo veet tefusato. shenayim – notlan veet tefusatan.

a: Matza shelosha – im yesh benehen mearba ad shemone, hare zo shechunat kevarot, uvodek mimmennu ulehallan esrim amma. matza echad besof esrim amma – bodek mimmennu ulehallan esrim amma, sheraglayim laddavar. sheillu mittechilla metzao – notlo veet tefusato.
Amar mar: mearba vead shemone. manni? i rabbanan – ha amri: arba ammot al shesh! i rabbi shimon – ha amar: shesh al shemone!

Leolam rabbi shimon hi, vehay tanna hu – detanya: metzaan retzufin, veen benehen mearba ammot ad shemone – yesh lahen tefusa, veen lahen shechunat kevarot. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: roin et haemtzaiyyim keillu enan, vehashshear mitztarfin mearba ammot vead shemone.
Bemay okemta – kerabbi shimon? ema sefa: bodek hemennu ulehallan esrim amma. manni? i rabbi shimon, esrim vetarten havyayn! i rabbanan, tamne sere havyayn!
Leolam rabbanan hi, uchegon divdak baalachsona.
Umiddeha baalachsona – ha name baalachsona; esrim vetarte havyayn! chada baalachsona amrinan, tere baalachson la amrinan.
b: Rav shisha bereh derav idi amar: leolam rabbi shimon hi, vehacha bemay askinan – benifle.
Umiddeha benifle – ha name benifle; tamne sere havyayn! chada benifle amrinan, tarte benifle la amrinan.
Verame derabbanan adderabbanan, verame derabbi shimon adderabbi shimon –
Detanya: kerem hannatua al pachot mearba ammot – rabbi shimon omer: eno kerem. vachachamim omrim: hare ze kerem, veroin et haemtzaiyyim keillu enan.
Kashya derabbanan adderabbanan, vekashya derabbi shimon adderabbi shimon!
Derabbi shimon adderabbi shimon la kashya – hatam, la nati inashe addata lemikar; hacha, zimnin demitreme leh ben hashshemashot, umikkere umannechi leh.
Derabbanan adderabbanan name la kashya – hacha, kevan deminnavval – la mikkere kever; hatam, memar amar: he minnayyhu deshappir – shappir, udela shappir – leheve letzive.
Hadaran alach hammocher perot

Haomer lachavero: "bet kor afar ani mocher lach" – hayu sham nekaim amukkim asara tefachim, o selaim gevohin asara tefachim – enan nimdadin immah. pachot mikkan – nimdadin immah. veim amar lo: "kevet kor afar" – afillu hayu sham nekaim amukkim yoter measara tefachim, o selaim gevohin yoter measara tefachim, hare ellu nimdadin immah.
Gemara tenan hatam: hammakdish sadehu bishat hayyovel, noten lo levet zera chomer seorim – chamishshim shekel kasef. hayu sham nekaim amukkim asara tefachim, o selaim gevohin asara tefachim –

a: En nimdadin immah. pachot mikkan – nimdadin immah.
Veammay? likdeshu beanpe nafshayyhu! vechi tema: kevan dela have bet kor, la kadshi;
Veha tanya: "sade" – ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar: "zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef"; en li ella shehikdish bainyan hazze,
Minnayin lerabbot letech vachatzi letech, sea, tarkav vachatzi tarkav? talmud lomar: "sade", mikkol makom!
Amar rav ukeva bar chama: hacha binkaim meleim mayim askinan, delav bene zeria ninhu. dayka name, dekatane dumeya dislaim; shema minna.
I hachi, afillu pachot mikkan name! hanhu "negane deara" mikkeru; "shidre deara" mikkeru.
Hacha may? amar rav pappa: af al pi sheen meleim mayim. may tama? en adam rotze sheyyitten meotav bimkom echad, veyerau lo kishnayim ushelosha mekomot.
Matkef la ravina: veha dumeya dislaim katane – ma selaim delav bene zeria ninhu, af hane name delav bene zeria ninhu! ki katane dumeya dislaim – appachot mikkan.

Pachot mikkan nimdadin immah. amar rabbi yitzchak: terashim sheamru – bet arbaat kabbin. amar rav ukeva bar chama: vehu shemmuvelain bachameshet kabbin. rav chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: vehu shemmuvelain berubbah shel sade.
Bae rav chiyyay bar abba: rubban bemiutah, umiutan berubbah, mahu? teku.
Bae rabbi yirmeya:
b: Keshir mahu? keshura mahu? itztedinin mahu? derech akallaton mahu? teku.
Tana: im haya sela yechidi, afillu kol shehu – en nimdad immah. veim haya samuch lammetzer, afillu kol shehu – en nimdad immah.
Bae rav pappa: mufesak afar bentayim, mahu? teku. bae rav ashe: afar millematta vetzunema lemala; afar millemala vetzunema millematta – mahu? teku.

Mishna "bet kor afar ani mocher lach – midda bechevel", pichet kol shehu – yenakke, hotir kol shehu – yachazir. veim amar: "hen chaser hen yater", afillu pichet rova lisa, o hotir rova lisa – higgio. yoter mikkan, yaase cheshbon.

Ma hu machazir lo? maot. veim ratza, machazir lo karka. velama amru machazir lo maot? leyaypot kocho shel mocher – sheim shiyyer bassade bet tisha kabbin, uvagginna bet chatzi kav; uchedivre rabbi akiva – bet rova; machazir lo et hakkarka. velo et harova bilvad hu machazir, ella et kol hammotar.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: "bet kor" setama, may? ta shema: "bet kor afar ani mocher lach – midda bechevel",

a: Pachot kol shehu – yenakke, yater kol shehu – yachazir. ha setama – kehen chaser hen yater" dame!
Ema sefa – veim amar lo: "hen chaser hen yater"; afillu pichet rova lisa o hotir rova lisa – higgio. ha setama – kemidda bechevel dame! ella meha lekka lemishma minna.

Ta shema: "bet kor afar ani mocher lach"; "kevet kor afar ani mocher lach"; "hen chaser hen yater ani mocher lach" – afillu pichet rova lisa, o hotir rova lisa – higgio. alma setama name, kehen chaser hen yater" dame! hatam, paroshe ka mefaresh – ezehu bet kor shehi kevet kor? kegon daamar leh: "hen chaser hen yater".
Matkef la rav ashe: im ken, "ani mocher lach" "ani mocher lach" lema li? ella lav shema minna setama name kehen chaser hen yater" dame? shema minna.
Mahu machazir lo? maot vechulei. leyappot kocho shel mocher amrinan, leyappot kocho shel lokeach la amrinan?!
Vehatanya: pichet shivat kabbin umechetza lechor, o hotir shivat kabbin umechetza lechor – higgio. yoter mikkan – kofin et hammocher limkor veet hallokeach likkach.
Hatam, kegon dahava yakkira meikkara, vezal hasheta; deamrinan leh: i ara yahavat li – hav li kezula dehashta.
Vehatanya: keshehu noten lo – noten lo keshaar shellakach mimmennu! hatam, kegon dahava zula meikkara, veyakra la hasheta.
Sheim shiyyer bassade bet tisha kabbin vechulei. amar rav huna: tisha kabbin sheamru, vaafillu bevika gedola.
Verav nachman amar: noten shivat kabbin umechetza lechol kor vachor.
b: Vei ikka milleta yattira, dehave letishat kabbin – hadri.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: "sheim shiyyer bassade bet tishat kabbin" – lav dezabben leh korayim? la, dezabben leh kor.
"Uvagginna bet chatzi kav" – lav dezabben leh satayim? la, dezabben leh sea.
"Uchedivre rabbi akiva, bet rova" – may, lav dezabben leh sea? la, dezabben leh chatzi sea.
Bae rav ashe: sade – venaaset ginna; ginna – venaaseta sade, may? teku.
Tana: im haya samuch lesadehu – afillu kol shehu, machazir lo karka.
Bae rav ashe: bor, mahu shettafsik? ammat hammayim, mahu shettafsik? derech harabbim, mahu shettafsik? richba dedikla, mahu shettafsik? teku.
Velo et harova bilvad machazir lo, ella kol hammotar. kelappe leyay? tane ravin bar rav nachman: lo et hammotar bilvad machazir lo, ella et kol harvain kullan.
Mishna "midda bechevel ani mocher lach, hen chaser hen yater" – bittel "hen chaser hen yater" "midda bechevel". "hen chaser hen yater, midda bechevel" –

a: Bittel "midda bechevel" "hen chaser hen yater"; divre ben nannas.

Gemara amar rabbi abba bar memel amar rav: cholkin alav chaverav al ben nannas. may ka mashma lan? tenena: maase betzippori, beechad shessachar merchatz mechavero bishnem asar zehuvim leshana – dinar zahav lechodesh;
Uva maase lifne rabban shimon ben gamliel velifne rabbi yose, veamru: yachloku et chodesh haibbur!
I mehatam, hava amena: hatam hu deikka lememar mihdar ka hadar beh, veikka lememar paroshe ka mefaresh. aval hacha, devadday ka hadar beh, ema la; ka mashma lan.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: zo divre ben nannas, aval chachamim omrim: hallech achar pachot shebballeshonot.
"Zo" – vela sevira leh?! veha rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: "kor bishloshim ani mocher lach" – yachol lachazor bo afillu bassea haacharona.
"Kor bishloshim – sea besela ani mocher lach" – rishon rishon kana. ella "zo" – usevira leh.
Umi sevira leh?! vehaamar shemuel: beva baemtza hachodesh askinan; aval ba bitchillat hachodesh – kullo lammaskir. besof hachodesh – kullo lassocher!
b: Ella leolam "zo" – vela sevira leh. vehatam tama may – mishshum detafes,
Hacha name – ha tafes.
Amar rav huna, amri be rav: "istera, mea mae" – mea mae. "mea mae, istera" – istera.
May ka mashma lan – tefos lashon acharon? ha amra rav chada zimna – deamar rav: i havay hatam, hava yahevna kulleh lemaskir!
I ittemar ha vela ittemar ha, hava amena: mihdar ka hadar beh. aval hacha, mahu detema paroshe ka mefaresh; ka mashma lan.

a: Mishna "besimanav uvimtzarav"; pachot mishshetut – higgio, ad shetut – yenakke.
Gemara ittemar, rav huna amar: shetut – kefachot mishshetut. rav yehuda amar: shetut – keyoter mishshetut.

Rav huna amar: shetut kefachot mishshetut – hachi kaamar: pachot mishshetut, ushetut bakkelal – higgio. yoter mishshetut – yenakke. rav yehuda amar: shetut keyoter mishshetut – hachi kaamar: pachot mishshetut – higgio. ad shetut, ushetut bakkelal – yenakke.
Metivi: "besimanav uvimtzarav", pichet shetut o hotir shetut – hare hu keshum haddayyaynin, higgio. veha shum haddayyaynin, dishtut keyoter mishshetut hu!

Amar lecha rav huna: uletamaych, "higgio" ka tane! ella keshum haddayyaynin – velo keshum haddayyaynin; keshum haddayyaynin – lishtut, velo keshum haddayyaynin – deillu hatam, batel mikkach; veillu hacha, higgio.
Rav pappa zevan ara mehahu gavra,
b: Amar leh: havya esrin gerive. meshacheh, vela havay ella chamesra. ata lekammeh deabbaye, amar leh: sevart vekabbelt.
Vehatnan: pachot mishshetut – higgio, ad shetut – yenakke! hane mille hecha dela kim leh begavva, aval hecha dekim leh begavva – sevar vekabbel.
Veha esrin amar li! amar leh: daadifa keesrin.
Tanya, rabbi yose omer: haachin shechalku, kevan sheala goral leechad mehen – kanu kullam. may tama? amar rabbi elazar: kitchillat eretz yisrael – ma techilla begoral, af kan begoral.
I – ma lehallan bekalpi veurim vetummim, af kan bekalpi veurim vetummim?! amar rav ashe: behahu hanaa deka tzayyti lahadade, gamri umaknu lahadade.
Ittemar: shene achin shechalku, uva lahen ach mimmedinat hayyam; rav amar: batla machloket, ushemuel amar: mekammetzin.
Amar leh rava lerav nachman: lerav deamar batla machloket, alma hadar dina; ella meatta, hane be telata dekayymi, vaazul be tere minnayyhu ufelug, hachi name devatla machloket?
Hachi hasheta?! hatam, nechitu addata deve telata meikkara; hacha, la nechitu addata deve telata meikkara.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: lishmuel deamar mekammetzin – lememra dekam dina?! veha rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: "kor bishloshim ani mocher lach" – yachol lachazor bo afillu bisa haacharona. "kor bishloshim – sea besela ani mocher lach" – rishon rishon kana!
